definitions.gloss: to bend, to curve, to make crooked
definitions.explanation: To change something from straight to curved or angled.
To alter or misrepresent information; to bend the rules.

examples.japanese: ⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{曲|ま}げて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{針金|はりがね}→針金：04324_harigane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{曲|ま}げて⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Bend the wire to make a shape.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{曲|ま}げて⟦{報道|ほうどう}する→報道する：04438_houdou⟧。
⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{曲|ま}げて⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}った→拾う：00845_hirou⟧。
examples.english: I bent down and picked up the luggage.

examples.english: You must not twist the truth to suit your convenience.

notes:
{曲|ま}げる is a transitive verb meaning to bend something or to distort.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Pair: ⟦{曲|ま}がる→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧ (intransitive - to bend, to turn)
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{曲|ま}げる

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{曲|ま}げる (bend one's back)
- ⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{曲|ま}げる (bend one's knee)
- ⟦{角|かど}→角：02195_kado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{曲|ま}げる (turn a corner) *more commonly uses ⟦{曲|ま}がる→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧

USAGE:
- ⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{曲|ま}げる (distort facts)
- ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{曲|ま}げる (bend the law)
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{曲|ま}げない (not change one's opinion)
